shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Three uniformly-efficient per-level sizes (126/190/254) bought from a 146,000-cell budget. Wall-mounted junction and breaker boxes bridge power and pipe networks between levels across six supported utility mods. Per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop item 3776015553.
body:
> **NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 utility networks; §31 publishing. Keep every ⚠ - each cost a run to learn.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. ~78 files, ~24,150 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

**CURRENT PHASE: SHIPPED, OPEN BETA, BACK IN BUILD MODE.** Published 2026-08-01 as **Workshop item 3776015553** (public). The folder was stripped for the upload and has since been **fully restored** - `Source/`, `Tools/`, `.git`, `.gitignore` are all back in place and `build_mod` is green. See §31.

**⚠ THE VERIFICATION TABLE BELOW WAS RE-BASED 2026-08-01.** The user tested the 190 and 254 tiers, all 15 utility networks, the elevator and the multi-hop stair router **outside Modmixer, without the agent present**. Those are no longer open items. Do not re-flag them as untested on the strength of this file's older entries - the test-run log in §9 only records agent-driven runs and is therefore an INCOMPLETE record of what has been exercised.

**The standing risk (unchanged).** §29's depth cut ships ON, judged by eye only. **Any performance report on a mountainous map: throw `MassDepthCutEnabled` first.**

**How to test §30.** `run_test_cycle` with all six `companionMods` or 28 of 30 defs stay behind their LoadFolders gate. Pin `AB2: riser report` and `AB2: open all bands`. **Run the report BEFORE theorising** - it separates five failure causes that look identical in game.

---

## Status
Visuality, QOL, altitude/weather, settings VERIFIED.
**✅ §24b ✅ §24c ✅ §27 ✅ §28 ✅ §29 accepted on look (#260).**
**✅ §2 NEW LADDER generates clean.** All three tiers exercised (126 across runs #276-#284; 190 and 254 by the user out of band).
**✅ §30 ALL 15 NETWORKS LINK AND ARE EXERCISED.** DBH water verified in play (#284); the rest confirmed by the user out of band.
**✅ Elevator and multi-hop stair router exercised by the user out of band.**
**🔧 §25 FIXED, UNVERIFIED** - needs the reporter's save.
**🔧 §30a power gutter clamp BUILT, UNVERIFIED.**
**🎨 ART: only the power junction has real art (3 files). 87 of 90 riser textures are generated placeholders. DISCLOSED at the top of the Workshop description. THE HEADLINE BETA GAP.**
**⚠ CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT IS PARTIAL** - down works, up does not render. DISCLOSED.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount * Slot)`. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + 2) / 64) * 64`; **64-alignment of SLOT is load-bearing**.

**The one insight.** `Region.Neighbors` is *topological, not spatial*. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms, temperature or vacuum. Reachability is not a path: 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK DOES NOT GENERALISE TO UTILITY NETWORKS.** `RegionLink` is read by the region graph and NOTHING else. Every power/pipe system builds its graph from raw CELL ADJACENCY and never consults regions, so edges must be ADDED to each system's own builder (§30).

**⚠ THE GUTTER IS UNBUILDABLE BY CONSTRUCTION.** `AB_OpenAir` declares **no affordances**; every building needs `terrainAffordanceNeeded` Light. Combined with every net builder stepping ONE cardinal cell, **no cell-adjacency net can cross a band unaided.**

**Hard 1.6 constraints.** Path grid is IJobParallelFor over EVERY cell. No `PathFinder.FindPath`. **⚠ The stack is 2x to 7x anisotropic.**

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, eight shapes
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Anchor, a fraction of `Size.z` | river/lake centre; VEE Crater jitter | remap the point |
| Field, a gradient on map centre | coastline; VEE LoneIsland | re-centre the sample |
| Noise space, a slice is not a short map | Map Preview (§6d); GL grids (§22); Rimefeller oil (§30e) | generate full height, then crop |
| Distance-to-extent | `CloseToEdge`, no-build edge; river WIDTH | re-base onto the band rect |
| Aspect ratio, normalised by BOTH dims | preview + reroll grid (§6d) | lay out from the BAND, generate at the STACK |
| Map-wide scalar | snow melt, temperature readout, GL roof sweep | rewrite per cell at the consumer |
| Foreign absolute writes (§22) | GL landform output lands in band 0 | ORDER, not arithmetic |
| Radius search wider than the gutter (§30a) | `ConnectMaxDist` 6 vs a 3-cell gap | clip the rect to the band |

Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley. **`ABBandLocal.cs` is THE canonical FIELD rewrite** plus `BandLocalModule`.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — budget 146,000, ladder 7 / 4 / 2

| size | slot | gutter | gap | cost/band | playable | max levels | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 126 | 128 | 2 | 3 | 16,128 | 98.4% | 7 (cap) | 112,896 |
| **190** | 192 | 2 | 3 | 36,480 | 99.0% | **4** | 145,920 |
| 254 | 256 | 2 | 3 | 65,024 | 99.2% | 2 | 130,048 |

**⚠ EXACTLY ONE MAXIMALLY EFFICIENT HEIGHT PER 64-STEP, SO ANCHORING ONE TIER FIXES THE LADDER.** Efficient heights are `slot - 2`: **62, 126, 190, 254, 318, 382**, spaced 64 apart. Keeping 190 *determined* 126 and 254.
**⚠ UNIFORM GUTTER IS A TESTING WIN.** Every tier is gutter 2 / gap 3, so gutter behaviour no longer changes with the size pick - the confound §30a walked into.
**⚠ WHAT WAS GIVEN UP.** 250/300 were vanilla Medium/Large exactly. **318 is blocked by arithmetic** (2 x 101,760 = 203,520). **62 is deliberately absent** - `SeamMarginFor` takes 13% and 126 already starved two scatterers. **The wide gutter was real safety and is gone**: at gap 3 every tier is inside a foreign radius helper's reach.
**⚠ THE BUDGET CUT.** 146,000 = 4 x 190, down 24% from a figure set by the heaviest tier - and 300 was **never generated once**. 192,000 exceeded every vanilla map (2.13x Large). **Generation cost tracks BAND size, not total cells** (#238 5x190/182,400 = 8.3 s vs #236 3x250/192,000 = 12.4 s). **NOT based on measured framerate** - §10's benchmark measures steady state, not burst.
**⚠ COST SPREAD WAS INVERTED AND NOW IS NOT.** Old 1.70x with the SEVEN-level tier cheapest; now 1.29x, so the size pick is about **shape, not speed**.
**⚠ 200 IS STILL THE ONE NUMBER TO AVOID** - gutter 56, 21.9% wasted. **Waste is a SAWTOOTH.**
**Old saves are safe** - `bandHeight` scribed, `SlotFor` generic, `Sizes` never consulted on the load path.
**⚠ THE PLAN PERSISTS BETWEEN COLONIES.** Read the PLAN line before believing any size test.
**⚠ Own the widget, do not patch the data.** Chooser writes `GameInitData.mapSize`; state released in a `Finalizer`.

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA
**Cross-band movement** segmented at ONE interception; hops strictly decrease. Multi-hop exercised by the user out of band.
**⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE: `TryResolveVisibleBelow`.** TEN systems share it; NINE appearances of the single-step bug. **`TryResolveVisibleFrom` is THE gate, and it answers TWO questions.** **§29 adds a second, rendering-only descent BESIDE it.**
**⚠ THE BELOW VIEW IS MIRRORED PASSES, NOT ONE RENDERER** (§6a). **⚠ THREE THINGS ARE CALLED "MASS".** **⚠ MASS FILL IS EMITTED FROM THREE PLACES.** **⚠ THE CAP IS SINGLE-STEP.** **⚠ VISIBILITY IS `ABBands.ShowsBelow(terrain)`.** **⚠ A `dontRender` VIEWING CELL MEANS OUR FILL IS THE ONLY BACKDROP.**
**⚠ EVERY FOREIGN NETWORK SHIPS ITS OWN `SectionLayer` AND NONE ARE MIRRORED** (§30f).
**Water** is TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE, **all three patches inert under GL** (§22). **⚠ 6d-CLAMP: `PlannedSize`, not `Clamp`.** **⚠ MAP PREVIEW SHIPS IN TWO HALVES AND GL BUNDLES ONE.**
**⚠ PERSPECTIVE MODE WAS BUILT AND REMOVED. Do not re-add as polish.**
Ore `x(1+0.45*(depth-1))`. **⚠ The snow line never worked.** Camera clamp + level-switch share `ABGuard.Camera`.

# 9. GENERATION COST

## 9a. The profile stamps its own conditions
`TILE`, `PLAN`, `SCOPING:`, two censuses, the bisect state. Has voided or explained EIGHT comparisons. **⚠ THE WATER REPORT DOES NOT AND SHOULD.**

## 9c-9f. Measured cost curve

**⚠ THIS TABLE RECORDS AGENT-DRIVEN RUNS ONLY.** The user has generated at 190 and 254 outside Modmixer; those runs are not here. Absence from this table is NOT evidence a configuration is unexercised.

**OLD LADDER** (plans no longer offered; per-band timings still hold): #231 7x126 Flat ~5.7 s | #236 3x250 SmallHills carve **7,118** ~12.4 s | #237 5x190 Mtn ~6.9 s | #238 5x190 SmallHills ~8.3 s | #255 5x190 Mtn Boreal **~4.1 s** (best) | #259/#260 5x190 +Caves ~5.3/5.8 s.

**NEW LADDER** (146,000 budget, all 5x126):
| run | tile | gensteps | carve | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| #276 | Flat TempForest, rain 1327 | 1,447 | 1,218 | ~2.9 s |
| #277 | LargeHills +Caves +River, rain 2221 | 1,695 | 1,510 | ~3.4 s |
| #278 | Flat ExtremeDesert, rain 158 | 743 | 674 | **~1.6 s** |
| #279 | LargeHills TempForest, rain 762 | 1,627 | 975 | ~2.8 s |

**⚠ THE NEW LADDER'S WHOLE RANGE (1.6-3.4 s) SITS BELOW THE OLD LADDER'S BEST (4.1 s).**
**⚠ FillRock is SUPERLINEAR in band size:** 1.75x cells -> 2.87x time. This killed the 250 tier.
**⚠ RAINFALL DOMINATES `GenStep_Plants`:** 25.3 ms at rain 158 vs 543 ms at rain 1327 - a **21x spread on the same plan**.
**⚠ THE `Caves` CLAIM IS DEMOTED TO A RANGE.** Recorded from n=2 as "~1.1-1.2 s in `MutatorPostElevationFertility`"; **#277 HAS Caves and that genstep took 49.6 ms**, the cost appearing in `MutatorPostTerrain` instead. **n=2 was not a pattern, again.**
**⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES WHETHER A RENDERING TEST IS VALID AT ALL.** A one-stone map cannot express a queue-ordering bug (§29).

## 9g. ⚠ RE-RANKED ON EVIDENCE
1. **Basement rock suppression** - ~1.0-4.3 s, tile-independent. **Item 1.**
2. `GenStep_Plants` scoping - rainfall-driven. **Demoted.**
3. `GenStep_RockChunks` - `Filth_RubbleRock` tops the destroyed census on EVERY tile. 4. Scattered ruins. 5. Perlin precompute.

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
59.6 fps at 96 pawns. **⚠ THAT MEASURES THE WRONG THING** - cost is in section-regeneration BURSTS.
**⚠ BISECT TOGGLES PERSIST ACROSS RUNS, AND THE STAMP IS WHY WE CATCH IT.** #172 opened with a stale `belowWater=False` that mimicked a fixed bug; **#277 opened with the same stale flag on a map that had a River.** Caught by the stamp both times.
**⚠ The pre-pinned palette always strips its LAST entry. n=18.** Pad with a DISTINCT throwaway.
**⚠ OUR PROFILE / BISECT / RISER lines arrive as `warning` ROWS ATTRIBUTED TO US** - a run reporting only those is CLEAN. **Info level is filtered out of the bridge, so a diagnostic that must reach the log has to be `Log.Warning`.**
**⚠ AN ERROR HASH IS A STACK SIGNATURE, NOT A FILE.** Rimefeller ships a malformed `Textures/Rimefeller/UI/discord.dds` that fails `ModDdsLoader.TryLoadDds` every run. Re-verify the `absFilePath` after changing art - **unless the build is byte-identical**, in which case re-drilling is waste.
**⚠ INSTRUMENT BEFORE THE THIRD GUESS.** §30c cost three test cycles to two wrong theories, then fell in ONE run to counters plus a `lastSkipReason` string.

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **ART.** 87 of 90 riser textures are placeholders - the headline beta gap and now a live, disclosed promise. Regenerate the power junction too; its north box is 65% off south's aspect. `Tools/TextureWorkbench.html` carries per-slot prompts and per-riser reference paths.
2. **CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT: upward shooting does not render.** The other disclosed beta gap.
3. **VERIFY §30a** at any tier (all gap 3 now).
4. **VERIFY §25 on the reporter's save.**
5. **Basement rock suppression** (§9g item 1).
6. **§30 polish:** `PipeGrid[P, cell]` is not rewritten on merge, so DBH's pipe overlay may still colour the two levels separately even though they share a net. Cosmetic; confirm against a real fixture before chasing.
7. §18 audit; VEE compat; GL roof fix; reroll grid; depth shrink; camera anchor; preview at 254.
8. **Never exercised:** basement PATHING, cavern basement.
9. **§22 TABLED.** 10. **CAI 5000** (§26). 11. **§30g** VTE's `RoofGrid_SetRoof_Patch` vs `ABSkySync`.
12. **§30e Rimefeller oil** slicing-rule bug - `BandLocalModule` is the drop-in fix, not built.
13. **Delete the orphaned private Workshop item 3773267907** (§31).

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove a subsystem innocent by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. Change one thing per experiment. **Run the diagnostic before the third theory** - and when there is no diagnostic, BUILD ONE. A beautiful fit is not evidence.
**⚠ THE AGENT'S TEST LOG IS NOT THE PROJECT'S TEST HISTORY.** The user tests outside Modmixer. Four items sat marked "never generated / untested" that had in fact been exercised. **Before writing an untested claim into player-facing copy, ASK.**
**⚠ A GUARD CLAUSE THAT SILENTLY EARLY-RETURNS IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM AN UNIMPLEMENTED FEATURE** (§30c). Counters at every early-return plus a `lastSkipReason` turned it into one line of fact.
**⚠ ASSERTING AN INVARIANT IS NOT ESTABLISHING IT.** Carry the ANSWER, not the assumption.
**⚠ HALF-IMPOSED ORDERING IS WORSE THAN NONE.** **⚠ COUNT THE EMITTERS BEFORE FIXING THE LOOK.** **⚠ CLEAR THE OTHER SUSPECT BY READING ITS DATA, NOT ITS CODE.** **⚠ A FIX FOR MOD X CAN BE A REGRESSION FOR EVERYONE WITHOUT X.** **⚠ REPRODUCING A SUBSYSTEM MEANS REPRODUCING ALL OF IT.** **⚠ REUSING A PREDICATE IS REUSING ITS HIDDEN CONDITIONS.** **⚠ TWO RESOLVERS FOR ONE QUANTITY IS A BUG WITH A DELAY FUSE.** **⚠ ASK HOW THE SUBSYSTEM REPRESENTS THE THING, NOT WHAT THE THING IS.**
**⚠ CHECK THAT YOUR CONFIGURATION CAN EXPRESS THE DIFFERENCE** - and **the TIER is part of that configuration**.
**⚠ A QUANTISED PARAMETER HAS FEWER LEGAL VALUES THAN IT LOOKS.** Slot is 64-aligned, so there is ONE efficient height per step.
**⚠ A BUDGET SET BY THE HEAVIEST OPTION IS PAID BY EVERY USER.** **Check which option SETS a limit and whether it has ever been exercised.**
**⚠ A COST MODEL CAN GOVERN THE WRONG AXIS AND STILL LOOK CORRECT.** The cell budget models pathfinding, not generation, which is superlinear in BAND size.
**⚠ IF THE CHEAPEST OPTION LOOKS LIKE THE MOST EXPENSIVE, THE UI IS LYING.**
**⚠ n=2 IS NOT A PATTERN, AND NEITHER IS n=4** - the Caves claim died at n=3.
**⚠ N MODS CAN BE FEWER THAN N PROBLEMS - COUNT THE CODEBASES.** Six mods, three patch families.
**⚠ A FOREIGN MOD'S OWN DEFS CAN BE WRONG - DO NOT COPY THEM BLIND.** Luciferium files its pipes under `VCHE_PipeNetworks`, a category defined by a mod it does not depend on.
**⚠ A DEPENDENCY LIST NAMES THE REAL PATCH TARGET.** **⚠ GATE AGAINST THE HOST MOD'S OWN UNLOCK, `MayRequire` INCLUDED.** **⚠ A MOD CAN HAVE A RESEARCH SYSTEM THAT IS NOT `ResearchProjectDef`.** **⚠ AN ENUM IS A CAPABILITY LIST, NOT A CONTENT LIST.**
**⚠ TWO CALL SITES OF ONE CONSTANT CAN NEED TWO DIFFERENT FIXES** (§30a).
**⚠ A DECOMPILE SHOWS THE API OF THE VERSION THAT MOD WAS BUILT AGAINST.** VEF's DLL calls `ThingDef.IsWall()`; in 1.6 it is a PROPERTY.
**⚠ A LOSSY NORMALISER IS NOT A WAY TO READ A CHOICE.** **⚠ A RULE ENFORCED BY GREPPING A SYNTAX ONLY CATCHES THAT SYNTAX.** **⚠ A DESIGN CHOICE RECORDED WITHOUT ITS COST WILL BE READ AS FREE.** **⚠ THE REAL CONFLICT IS USUALLY A REPLACEMENT, NOT A COLLISION.** **⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT IS ALREADY BUILT BEFORE BUILDING IT.**
**⚠ Compat work is mostly deletion.** **⚠ Waste is often a sawtooth.** **⚠ Duplication is how an invariant dies.** **⚠ A comment is not an invariant.** **⚠ Steady-state fps hides burst cost.** **⚠ Timing that reads exactly 0.0 ms is an early return.** **⚠ In a foreign log, the loudest error is usually downstream.**
**Patching.** Re-aim the shared parameter. Find the ONE method everything funnels through - and when there is none, **wrap the DATA instead of the reader**. Patch the PRODUCER, not the store. Own the widget. **Never put a foreign type in a patch signature** - resolve by name in `Prepare`, type `__instance` as `object`. **Prefix state is released in a Finalizer.** **Prefer "detect, then redo" over "always redo".** **⚠ Harmony binds postfix parameters BY NAME.**
**Engine facts.** `SnowGrid.CanHaveSnow` rejects on a `holdSnowOrSand=false` terrain OR a Full-fillage edifice. A `TerrainHard` shader IGNORES vertex alpha; set `renderQueue` AFTER shader assignment. **Draw order between terrain materials is render QUEUE.** A `dontRender` terrain emits only a ShadowMask. `Banded` is FALSE during map generation. FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread. **Gensteps run with live-map bookkeeping DEFERRED (~40x cheaper).** Harmony always runs FINALIZERS. **`FogGrid` is a `NativeBitArray` in 1.6.** **Vanilla rock links with `MapEdge`.** `Building.SpawnSetup` registers with the edifice grid unconditionally. **`Graphic_Multi.Init` falls back to `_east` with `westFlipped` when `_west` is absent - a rotatable building needs only north/east/south.**
**⚠ WALL-MOUNTED DRAW LAYER IS `Item`, NOT `BuildingOnTop`** - tuned, not chosen. A riser shares the wall's cell and at `BuildingOnTop` the wall won the draw order on some facings. Known cost: floor items share the layer and can z-fight, acceptable because the cell is a wall.
**⚠ SOUTH-FACING WALL MOUNTS NEED ZERO DRAW OFFSET WHILE N/E/W NEED 0.9.** RimWorld's camera is top-down with a forward tilt, so the faces are not symmetric on screen. Restoring south to -0.9 "for symmetry" pushes it a full cell into the room.
**⚠⚠ RIMWORLD HAS TWO UNRELATED "WALL-MOUNTED" MECHANISMS AND THEY PLACE IN DIFFERENT CELLS.**
  - `isAttachment` + `Placeworker_AttachedToWall`: occupies the OPEN cell BESIDE a wall, Rotation points INTO the wall, and **the wall must declare `supportsWallAttachments` - ORDINARY COLONY WALLS DO NOT**.
  - `canPlaceOverWall` + a `PlaceWorker_OnWall`-style rule: occupies the WALL'S OWN cell, Rotation points OUT into the room. **Vanilla `Vent`, VTE's `WallMountedVent` and `WallMountedCooler` all use this** - it is what players mean by "wall mounted".
  **Consequence for art:** the first inverts the rotation convention; the second keeps the ordinary one. **`isEdifice=false` lets it share the wall's cell; `clearBuildingArea=false` stops placement demolishing that wall. Both load-bearing.**
**⚠ POWER FACTS.** `PowerNetMaker.ContiguousPowerBuildings` is PRIVATE; flood over `GenAdj.CellsAdjacentCardinal`. **`PowerConnectionMaker.ConnectMaxDist = 6`** with NO line-of-sight or region check. **`Building.TransmitsPowerNow` is VIRTUAL and the base IGNORES flicking** - `Building_PowerSwitch` overrides it with `FlickUtility.WantsToBeOn`, and `PowerNetManager.Notfiy_TransmitterTransmitsPowerNowChanged` (vanilla's typo) is the rebuild trigger. **`CompPower` resolves an ATTACHMENT's connector position from the wall it hangs on.** **⚠ A `private const` IS INLINED AND CANNOT BE READ BY REFLECTION.**
**⚠ COLLECTION FACT THAT COST A SESSION.** **`HashSet<T>` implements `ICollection<T>` but NOT the non-generic `System.Collections.ICollection`** - unlike `List<T>`. An `is ICollection` guard against a foreign `HashSet` field returns false EVERY time and silently disables the whole feature. Resolve `Add`/`Count` by shape via reflection instead.
**⚠ TEXTURE FACTS.** **Core textures are PACKED** - read MOD PNGs and treat VE art as the vanilla proxy. **TWO art families, near-opposites**: Dubwise is one faceplate recoloured per network with a **thick near-black outline**; Vanilla/VE is **almost no outline**, flat colour blocks. **Describe the SPRITE, not the object.**

# 30. CROSS-LEVEL UTILITY NETWORKS — ALL 15 LINK AND EXERCISED

## 30-DESIGN. JUNCTION + BREAKER, MERGE MODEL
- **Junction** - the machinery. Bridges to a partner one level UP *and* one DOWN, so one junction serves three levels. 60 steel + 2 components.
- **Breaker/receiver** - cheap, carries the switch. 25 steel + 1 component.
- Both **go INSIDE a wall** (`canPlaceOverWall`, see §14) and the pair must occupy the **same cell** on adjacent bands.
- **Names are thematic per network**: stopcock, damper, gate valve, isolator, disconnector, patch panel, shutoff, valve, pressure relief valve. **defNames are unchanged - they are save keys.**

**⚠ THE SPLIT IS PRESENTATIONAL, NOT A FLOW DIRECTION.** Once paired the networks MERGE and pool. **RimWorld's `PowerNet` has no one-way edge and neither does any foreign pipe system.**
**⚠ THE SWITCH IS `CompFlickable` FOR EVERY FAMILY.** VEF's `CompPipeValve.TransmitResourceNow => compFlickable.SwitchIsOn`; DBH's `Building_Valve` uses `FlickUtility.WantsToBeOn`; vanilla's power switch is `CompPowerTransmitter` + `CompFlickable`. **VEF breakers use `CompProperties_PipeValve` so the rebuild comes free; Dubwise ones get it free too because `CompPipe.ReceiveCompSignal` calls `DirtyPipeGrid` + `RegenPipeGrids` UNCONDITIONALLY on flick.**
**⚠ AUTO-SPAWNING THE TWIN IS NOT AVAILABLE.** The matching cell one level up frequently has no wall.

## 30-CORE. `ABRiserLink.AppendPartners` IS THE ONE ANSWER
Every family's patch funnels through it. **Symmetric by construction** - a junction looks for breakers, a breaker for junctions.
**⚠ THE PARTNER CELL IS `(x, z ± Slot)`, NOT `± bandHeight`.** Verified in play: junction (63,0,168) band 1, breaker (63,0,296) band 2, delta 128 = slot.
`ABRiserExt` carries `network` (**our** identifier) and `role`.

## 30a. 🔧 BUILT, UNVERIFIED: VANILLA POWER LEAKED ACROSS THE GUTTER
`ConnectMaxDist = 6` vs a 3-cell gap: an appliance near a band edge drew power through solid rock. **The RADIUS leaked; the FLOOD FILL did not.** Fix wraps and filters the iterator's `__result` (lossless) and uses **detect-then-redo** for the nearest-transmitter search. **⚠ NULLING A CROSS-BAND ANSWER WOULD BE WRONG** - vanilla picks the NEAREST.

## 30d. ✅ VEF PIPESYSTEM - ONE POSTFIX, SIX NETWORKS
`PipeNetManager.NeighbourThingsCardinal` is the **single funnel** for `RegisterConnector`, `UnregisterConnector` and `CreatePipeNetFrom`. **⚠ NOT ONE FOREIGN TYPE IN THE FILE.**

## 30-POWER. ✅ RE-ENTRANT MERGE
`ContiguousPowerBuildings` postfix **extends vanilla's answer by re-using the original on the far side**: find a riser whose partner is outside the component, ask the same method for the partner's component, union, repeat to closure. `Building_ABPowerBreaker : Building_PowerSwitch` supplies the flick override.
**⚠ THE `[ThreadStatic]` GUARD IS NOT OPTIONAL.** Without the latch that is unbounded recursion, and **a StackOverflowException in .NET is UNCATCHABLE**.

## 30c. ✅ DUBWISE - THREE HOSTS, ONE PATCH, WATER VERIFIED (#284)
`RebuildPipeGrid(int P)` postfix, `TargetMethods()` over all installed hosts, `object` everywhere.
**⚠ THE FLOOD IS UNPATCHABLE** - `PassCheck` is a local-function closure. So merge after the fact.
**⚠ MERGE BY REMOVAL, NOT BY SHARING.** Two nets sharing a member list on Rimefeller or Rimatomics would BOTH tick and silently double every pull, push and production rate. The loser is deleted from `PipeNets` and its pipes repointed.
**⚠ THE HOLDER IS `__instance`.** Re-finding it from `pipeNets.DeclaringType` lands on the ABSTRACT `UniversalPipeMapComp` for two of the three hosts.
**⚠ THE BUG THAT COST THREE CYCLES:** `is ICollection` against `HashSet<ThingWithComps> PipedThings`. See §14.

## 30e. RIMEFELLER OIL IS A SLICING-RULE BUG
`RegenSeedGrids()` runs Perlin over `map.AllCells` on absolute coordinates - oil pockets in SKY bands. **`BandLocalModule` is the drop-in fix.** Not built.
